<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex14022024-10-22-15-34" status="finalized"> 
<milestone n="dgod pa" unit="section"/>   
dang po ni <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="47b8"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4235">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4235">khu</rs></note> chos bzod chos shes <expan>gnyis</expan> ni mthong spang rgyun gcod pa dang thag sring pa'i bar chad med pa dang rnam grol gyi lam gnyis su skye la | rjes bzod rjes shes ni gnyis kar 'du ste | 'di ltar chos bzod kyis chos nyid ma dag pa mthong ba na de 'jal gyi <expan>ye shes</expan> de nyid kyi gzhan <pb edRef="inst:4574" n="48a"/><lb edRef="inst:4574" n="48a1"/> rig gi chos nyid rtogs pa dang | rang rig gi cha'i chos nyid rtogs pa la rjes bzod rjes shes su 'jog go || chos shes kyis chos nyid dag pa mthong ba na <expan>ye shes</expan> de nyid kyi gzhan rig dang rang rig gi cha'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i cha nas rjes bzod <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="48a2"/> rjes shes su 'jog go || de ltar yang bzod pa dang shes pa <expan>thams cad</expan> kyang mtshan ma med pas gnas pa'i rnal 'byor can du rig par bya'o zhes chos nyid kyi yul can kho nar bshad pas shes so zhes grag go ||</seg></TEI>
